title: How to Generate Cinematic AI Art with Free Midjourney Prompts
description:
I just found a Pinterest for AI prompts called MeiGen AI.
 
• It is a free gallery filled with thousands of high quality AI images that you can easily browse through.
• You can discover amazing styles like cinematic photography or anime illustrations.
• Once you find a look you like, you can copy the prompt and generate your own version.
• It is best to tweak the prompt a bit so you do not get the exact same image as the original.
• The platform works directly with models like GPT Image 2 and Midjourney so you do not need to learn prompt engineering.
• I actually generated the image for this reel through Strique.
 
Check out the prompt library here: https://www.meigen.ai/
Generate your images here: https://www.strique.io/
